description: This file defines different strategies for consuming Kafka topics within Spark's Kafka integration, including fixed partition assignment, topic subscription, and pattern-based subscription, along with utility methods for creating Kafka consumers and admin clients.

classes.name: ConsumerStrategy
classes.description: A sealed trait defining the interface for different Kafka consumption strategies, including methods for creating consumers, admin clients, and retrieving topic partitions.

classes.name: AssignStrategy
classes.description: Implements ConsumerStrategy for fixed partition assignment.

classes.name: SubscribeStrategy
classes.description: Implements ConsumerStrategy for subscribing to a list of topics.

classes.name: SubscribePatternStrategy
classes.description: Implements ConsumerStrategy for subscribing to topics matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka consumer based on the specified strategy and parameters.

methods.name: createAdmin
methods.description: Creates an Admin client for Kafka.

methods.name: assignedTopicPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of TopicPartition objects assigned or subscribed to.

methods.name: setAuthenticationConfigIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates Kafka parameters with security configs if necessary.

methods.name: retrieveAllPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves all partitions for given topics from Kafka admin.
